extraMeanings.en: to create or develop something through hard work
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She carved out a successful career in journalism.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gazetecilikte başarılı bir kariyer oluşturdu.

extraMeanings.en: to throw something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The fisherman cast his line into the river.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Balıkçı oltasını nehre attı.

extraMeanings.en: to give or record a vote
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Millions of people cast their votes in the election.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Seçimde milyonlarca insan oyunu kullandı.

extraMeanings.en: to make something happen
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The heavy rain caused serious flooding.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmur ciddi sellere yol açtı.

extraMeanings.en: an aim or principle that people support or fight for
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She donated a lot of money to a good cause.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hayırlı bir amaç için çok para bağışladı.

extraMeanings.en: a group forming part of a parliament
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bill was approved by the upper chamber.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yasa tasarısı üst meclis tarafından onaylandı.

extraMeanings.en: a repeated rhythmic phrase, typically shouted by a crowd
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The crowd broke into a chant of the team's name.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık takımın adını içeren bir tezahürata başladı.

extraMeanings.en: the tree that produces cherries
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They planted a cherry in the garden.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bahçeye bir kiraz ağacı diktiler.

extraMeanings.en: to think about something carefully over time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Let me chew it over before I decide.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Karar vermeden önce bırak enine boyuna düşüneyim.

extraMeanings.en: to break off a small piece from a hard material
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I chipped a tooth on a hard sweet.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sert bir şekerde dişimi kırdım.

extraMeanings.en: a track for motor racing
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The drivers completed twenty laps of the circuit.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sürücüler pistte yirmi tur tamamladı.

extraMeanings.en: the act or sound of clapping
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gave the singer a warm clap.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şarkıcıya içten bir alkış verdi.

extraMeanings.en: a sudden loud noise, especially of thunder
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A clap of thunder made everyone jump.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir gök gürlemesi herkesi yerinden sıçrattı.

extraMeanings.en: a fight or serious disagreement
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was a violent clash between police and protesters.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Polis ve protestocular arasında şiddetli bir çatışma yaşandı.

extraMeanings.en: of colours, to look bad together
extraMeanings.exampleEn: That red tie clashes with your green shirt.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O kırmızı kravat yeşil gömleğinle uyumsuz duruyor.

extraMeanings.en: to reach the most exciting or important point
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The festival climaxed with a huge firework display.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Festival muhteşem bir havai fişek gösterisiyle doruğa ulaştı.

extraMeanings.en: a feeling that a difficult experience has ended
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The trial gave the family a sense of closure.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dava aileye bir tür huzura kavuşma duygusu verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to come together in a group
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The children clustered around the teacher.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar öğretmenin etrafında kümelendi.

extraMeanings.en: to wind into rings or a spiral
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The snake coiled around the branch.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yılan dala sarıldı.

extraMeanings.en: to try to stop something bad from happening
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government introduced new laws to combat crime.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet suçla mücadele etmek için yeni yasalar çıkardı.

extraMeanings.en: a quick reply, often clever or funny
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I couldn't think of a good comeback at the time.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O anda iyi bir karşılık düşünemedim.
